atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Injects Tailwind's base, components, utilities, or variants styles into your CSS. (Tailwind CSS at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines existing Tailwind utility classes into a custom CSS rule. (Tailwind CSS at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Tells Tailwind which 'bucket' (base, components, utilities) a set of custom styles belongs to, controlling cascade order. (Tailwind CSS at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Specifies which Tailwind config file to use in this CSS file. (Tailwind CSS v4 at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing, etc.) as CSS custom properties, replacing the old tailwind.config.js theme object. (Tailwind CSS v4 at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Defines a new custom variant (e.g. a manually-toggled 'dark' class selector) that utilities can then use, such as dark:bg-black. (Tailwind CSS v4 at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom utility class that participates in Tailwind's variant system (hover:, dark:, etc. all work on it automatically). (Tailwind CSS v4 at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies a Tailwind variant (e.g. hover, dark) to a block of raw CSS inside a rule. (Tailwind CSS v4 at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Explicitly adds a file or directory to Tailwind's list of sources to scan for class names, in addition to automatic detection. (Tailwind CSS v4 at-rule.)

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Loads a Tailwind plugin directly from CSS. (Tailwind CSS v4 at-rule.)
